meta.title: Conversation sync
meta.description: Bidirectionally sync conversations across local and Remote-SSH machines discovered from ~/.ssh/config, including jump hosts. Import Claude Code, Codex CLI, generic JSONL and DeepSeek exports.

panel.title: Conversation sync — bidirectional + Remote-SSH
panel.subtitle: Left: all DSH sessions · Right: sessions on each machine · pick a direction to sync
panel.keyPath: Private-key PATH on this machine (stored as a DSH credential)
panel.arrowsHint: Select one session on each side, then choose a direction. A one-sided session is imported/exported first, then kept in sync.
panel.externalOnly: No DSH session yet — use Import to create one, or select a DSH session on the left before exporting.
panel.noExternal: No sessions found on this machine. Configure the SSH key and refresh.
panel.noBindings: No bindings yet. Pick two sessions above and choose a direction.
panel.pickLeft: Select a DSH session on the left first.
panel.pickRight: Select an external session on the right first.

warnings.writeBack: Warning: write-back edits the original tool's live files. A backup is taken before every write and restored on failure, but data loss is still possible.
